## Requirements

| # | requirement | where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | A1 `summarize(configuration, metric)` — point + selected interval, per-task distribution, (c,n), pass^k, tails, consistency, outcome counts, typed n/a, vetoed excluded-but-counted | `hh-analysis::summarize` over `hh_eval::scorecard` cell machinery |
| R2 | A2 `compare(arm_a, arm_b, metric, design)` — paired by task, replicate pairing only when `seed_honoured`, equal eval_budget, typed `UnmatchedBudget`/`IncommensurableMatch`/`MissingMatchSpec`, `budget_match.status`, paired effect, sign profile, tail effects, outcome_bounds (Manski), multiplicity, label | `hh-analysis::kernel` over `hh_eval::compare::compare` |
| R3 | A3 `contrast` — default difference-of-differences over fully crossed probed cells, task-clustered resampling, typed `ContrastUndefined` refusal, no zero-fill | `hh-analysis::kernel` over `hh_eval::compare::contrast` |
| R4 | A8 `equivalence` — three-valued TOST over pre-registration margins | `hh-analysis::kernel` over `hh_eval::benefits::equivalence_run` |
| R5 | A12 `multiplicity` — Holm over `primary_metrics × primary comparisons`, BH q-values over the rest, `exploratory` label without prereg, nothing suppressed | `hh-analysis::multiplicity` |
| R6 | Transfer rows — `benefit_kind = transfer`, paired held-out comparison, `transfer_ratio` + sign stability, typed unknowns | `hh_eval::benefits::transfer` via kernel |
| R7 | Results→analysis projection — `ResultsRow + RunManifest + LedgerFacts → EvalRun`, provenance/watermarks preserved, typed n/a kept, excluded/superseded/not-run/vetoed honoured | `hh-analysis::project` |
| R8 | Store-backed `lab.analysis.analyze` boundary op | `hh-embed` `analysis_ops` |
| R9 | `AnalysisRecord` persisted in LabDocs `{analysis_id, spec_ref}`; report persisted once, never recomputed | `hh-analysis::engine` + `hh-experiment::docs::kind` |
| R10 | KA-1/-2/-5/-8/-9/-12/-13 executable | `hh-analysis` tests |
| R11 | T_CLT corrected to ADR-0158's placeholder 100 (S3.3 landed 30) | `hh_eval::scorecard::T_CLT` |
| R12 | `permutation_signflip` p-values with effect+interval, never alone | `hh_eval::stats` + report test records |

## Plan

1. New crate `crates/hh-analysis` (C0/Stage-3 §6.4 kernel):
   - `project.rs` — `eval_run(row, manifest, facts, task_ctx, suite_ctx)`:
     honest field-by-field projection; `MissingClusterKey` when no task;
     open/unfinished rows excluded by the caller (typed), veto/outcome/
     `comparable` flags carried verbatim; `n/a` cells → `MetricValueKind::Na`
     never zero.
   - `kernel.rs` — `AnalysisInput` + `analyze(spec, input)`:
     `kind` dispatch → summarize / compare / interaction(contrast) /
     transfer / equivalence; additive `kind`/`spec_ref`/`label` members on
     `AnalysisSpec` (CC8); non-C0 kinds refuse `KindNotImplemented` typed.
   - `summarize.rs` — A1 via the extracted shared cell estimator.
   - `multiplicity.rs` — sign-flip permutation p (exact ≤20 tasks,
     deterministic seeded otherwise) + Holm (primaries) + BH (rest).
   - `report.rs` — `analysis_report_body/1` Json body
     `{kind, spec_ref, generated_from{watermark_set, run_ids_hash, seed,
     draws, metric_registry_version}, summaries, comparisons, contrasts,
     equivalence, multiplicity, labels, provenance}`; `report_id =
     H(spec_hash ∥ generated_from)` — KA-12 byte-identity.
   - `engine.rs` — `analyze_and_record`: LabDocs `analysis` (AnalysisRecord)
     + `analysis_report` (body) deposit; get-before-compute (never
     recomputes).
2. `hh-eval` (additive only): `T_CLT 30→100` (ADR-0158 OQ-367);
   `stats::permutation_signflip_p`; expose the per-cell estimator
   (`summarize_cell`) for kernel reuse.
3. `hh-experiment::docs::kind` += `ANALYSIS`, `ANALYSIS_REPORT`.
4. `hh-lab::analysis::AnalysisSpec` += `kind`, `spec_ref`, `label`
   (additive; decode default `summarize`).
5. `hh-embed`: `labi("lab.analysis.analyze")` + dispatch +
   `analysis_ops.rs` (resolve spec_ref → ExperimentSpec → design/arms/
   prereg; QuerySpec filters → `hh_results::QuerySpec`; manifests + facts
   from the ledger store; contexts records-in).
6. Tests: unit (project/kernel/multiplicity), integration (store→analyze
   seam, embed op), KA-1/-2/-5/-8/-9/-12/-13 acceptance.
7. ADR (S3.4c rulings): hh-analysis crate home; T_CLT correction; the
   report-body doc under `result_ref`; the AC-3/-6/-7/-11 Stage-4 split;
   the permutation-p enumeration rule; the projection defaults.

## Evidence report

- `crates/hh-analysis` — the Stage-3 estimator kernel:
  - `project.rs` — `eval_run(row, manifest, facts, task_ctx, suite_ctx)`:
    field-by-field projection over the durable `ResultsRow`; task
    coordinate from `coordinates.task` else `manifest.task_ref`
    (`MissingClusterKey` refusal — never a fabricated cluster);
    `n/a` cells stay `MetricValueKind::Na`; veto/outcome/`comparable`
    flags carried verbatim; unknown consumption dims and non-terminal
    rows refuse typed.
  - `kernel.rs` — `analyze(spec, input)`: `summarize` (A1 per-cell +
    per-stratum + `pass^k` detail rows), `compare` (A2 matched-budget
    paired via `hh_eval::compare`), `interaction` (A3 `contrast` over two
    arm pairs), `equivalence` (A8 via `equivalence_run_full` — margins
    only from `PreRegistration`), `transfer` (held-out delta + ratio +
    sign-stability region); `KindNotImplemented` for the C1 kinds.
  - `multiplicity.rs` — the A12 pass: sign-flip raw p, Holm over the
    pre-registered primary family, BH over the exploratory remainder,
    `family_size`/`method`/`label` on each comparison; nothing
    suppressed.
  - `report.rs` — `analysis_report_body/1` `{schema, report_id, kind,
    spec_ref?, generated_from, summaries, summary_details, comparisons,
    contrasts, equivalence?, transfer?, excluded.not_run, labels.report,
    provenance}`; `report_id = H(spec_hash ∥ generated_from)`.
  - `engine.rs` — `analyze_and_record`: `report_id` computable before
    estimation; a `get_named(ANALYSIS_REPORT, report_id)` hit serves the
    stored body verbatim (label-derived status on the hit — an
    exploratory report stays exploratory); otherwise persists the record
    + envelope + named body.
- `hh-eval` (additive): `T_CLT` corrected 30→100 (ADR-0158's constant);
  `stats::permutation_signflip_p` (exact `2^n` ≤ `SIGNFLIP_EXACT_MAX_N
  = 20`, seeded XorShift64 +1-smoothed Monte-Carlo above — never an
  impossible zero, always riding with the effect/interval);
  `benefits::equivalence_run_full` returns `(CompareOutcome,
  EquivalenceReport)` — `equivalence_run` keeps its report-only shape;
  `descriptor`/`run_numeric`/`cell_interval` exported for the kernel.
- `hh-lab::analysis` — `AnalysisSpec` += `kind`/`spec_ref`/`label`
  (CC8 additive; absent decodes `summarize`/`None`/`None` — the only
  shape pre-S3.4c could express); `Multiplicity` += `raw_ppm`/
  `adjusted_ppm`/`label`.
- `hh-experiment::docs::kind` += `ANALYSIS` / `ANALYSIS_REPORT`.
- `hh-embed` — `labi("lab.analysis.analyze")` + `analysis_ops.rs`:
  spec decode → `LabDocs` → `ResultsStore` row resolution → per-row
  `RunManifest` + `LedgerFacts` projection from the ledger prefix →
  `spec_ref` resolution (design/arms/pre-registration through the
  registered `hh-experiment/1` doc; named `budget` docs resolve the arm
  refs) → `analyze_and_record` → `{record, report, body}`. Refusals map
  typed (`BadSpec` → `SchemaViolation`, everything else → `Refused`).
- Tests (`crates/hh-analysis/tests/kernel.rs`, 20):
  `projection_field_fidelity`, `projection_refusals`,
  `summarize_renders_per_stratum_cells_and_details`,
  `summarize_inapplicable_class_renders_na_class`,
  `one_task_undefined_reducer_renders_na`,
  `compare_produces_paired_report_through_analyze`,
  `compare_refuses_unequal_hard_limits`,
  `compare_refuses_incommensurable_match`,
  `interaction_contrast_recovers_did`,
  `equivalence_verdict_within_margin`,
  `equivalence_requires_preregistration`,
  `transfer_profile_sign_stability_and_region`,
  `transfer_ratio_na_when_delta_in_unidentified`,
  `multiplicity_null_fwer_and_labels`,
  `report_id_deterministic_and_served`,
  `outcome_bounds_sensitivity`,
  `ka1_bernoulli_factorial_coverage`,
  `ka2_heavy_tail_coverage_and_clt_substitution`,
  `pass_k_matches_formula`, `clustered_clt_finite_cluster_correction`.
- Tests (`crates/hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs`):
  `lab_analysis_analyze_round_trip` (register → seeded ledger runs +
  results rows → `{record, report, body}`; re-call serves the identical
  `report_id`), `lab_analysis_analyze_refusals` (unresolvable `spec_ref`
  → `SchemaViolation`; unknown row selector → `Refused`).

## Acceptance-criteria verdicts

- **AC-R-2.10.4-1** (KA-1) — MET: `ka1_bernoulli_factorial_coverage` runs
  the Bernoulli factorial sweep — the A3 contrast recovers δ ≥93% at
  nominal 95% coverage, clustered-CLT substitutes under `T_CLT` with the
  `substituted` label, and the Wilson/Beta(1,1) small-n rule holds ≥93%
  at its floor; a 1-task cell renders `n/a{estimator_undefined}`.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-2** (KA-2) — MET: `ka2_heavy_tail_coverage_and_clt_substitution`
  — heavy-tail fixture, `bootstrap_paired` recovers the mean shift ≥93%
  and CLT-on-money substitutes + labels.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-3** (KA-3 frontier) — Stage-4/C1 (S4.3): the kernel
  answers `KindNotImplemented` for `frontier` — recorded in the gap
  table, not silently dropped.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-5** (KA-5) — MET: `outcome_bounds_sensitivity` exercises
  the Manski outcome-bounds table over outcome-class reassignments —
  headline Δ unchanged, `sensitive`/`robust` verdicts land.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-6** (KA-6 transfer) — MET at the row level:
  `transfer_profile_sign_stability_and_region` covers held-out delta +
  sign stability + the conditionality region;
  `transfer_ratio_na_when_delta_in_unidentified` renders the typed
  unidentified `n/a` (never a zero ratio). `TransferProfile` persistence
  is S4.3 scope.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-7** (KA-7 rank) — Stage-4/C1 (S4.3): `KindNotImplemented`.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-8** (KA-8 cross-checks) — MET: `pass_k_matches_formula`
  checks `pass^k` against the τ-bench reference;
  `clustered_clt_finite_cluster_correction` checks the clustered SE
  against the finite-cluster reference; `interaction_contrast_recovers_did`
  recovers the planted DiD.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-9** (KA-9 null multiplicity) — MET:
  `multiplicity_null_fwer_and_labels` — FWER ≤5% on the primary family,
  BH q-values on the exploratory remainder, labels attached, nothing
  suppressed.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-11** (KA-11 search baseline) — Stage-4/C1 (S4.3):
  `pass_at_k`/`search_time_benefit` primitives already live in
  `hh-eval`; the decomposition kind refuses `KindNotImplemented`.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-12** (KA-12 reproducibility) — MET:
  `report_id_deterministic_and_served` (identical input tuple →
  identical `report_id`; the stored body serves without recomputation)
  + the boundary arm in `lab_analysis_analyze_round_trip`.
- **AC-R-2.10.4-13** (KA-13 gates) — MET: AC-I2-2 (unequal hard caps
  refuse `UnmatchedBudget`), AC-I2-3 (inapplicable class →
  `n/a{class}`), incomparable match → typed refusal, A8's
  pre-registration-only margins refuse `NoRegisteredMargins`.
- **removability(0…3)** — MET: `scripts/check-removability.sh` green;
  `hh-analysis` is a leaf crate (one inbound edge, `hh-embed`); the op
  removes with the crate + dispatch arm + `labi` flag.
- **Universal phase-gate AC** — this ledger, ADR-0280, the acceptance
  matrix, the verification block, the PR doc + ledger/index advance.
